title: Browser usage on Wikimedia, June 2011
facts: The pie chart shows browser usage on Wikimedia in June 2011.
Internet Explorer has the largest share at 38.2 percent, followed by Firefox at 25.4 percent.
Chrome accounts for 16.5 percent and Safari for 9.9 percent.
Opera has 4.4 percent, Other 4.2 percent and Android the smallest share at 1.4 percent.

title: Transport modes in a European city, 1960–2000

visual.title: Transport modes in a European city, 1960–2000

facts: The bar chart compares bus, car, bike and foot as transport modes in a European city in 1960, 1980 and 2000.
Car use increases from about 7 percent to roughly 25 percent and then nearly 40 percent, becoming the highest in 2000.
Walking declines from around 35 percent to roughly 20 percent and then about 10 percent.
Cycling also declines, from around 27 percent to about 22 percent and then about 7 percent.
Bus use rises from about 20 percent to around 27 percent before falling to about 18 percent.

title: Percentage of people in Britain who buy pop music

visual.title: Percentage of people in Britain who buy pop music

facts: The bar chart compares pop-music purchasing in Britain by gender and age group.
The 25–34 and 16–24 groups are highest, at just over 30 percent, with the 25–34 group slightly higher.
Men are at roughly 28 percent, compared with about 19 percent for women.
The 35–44 group is around 25 percent, while people aged 45 and above are lowest at about 10 percent.

title: Tomato plant life cycle
facts: The diagram shows a repeating tomato plant life cycle with directional arrows.
Seeds develop into a young plant, which grows into a mature plant.
The mature plant produces flowers, followed by fruit.
The fruit contains seeds, which begin the next cycle.
